description: Baseline for release.tools repos. Extends the shared MihaiBojin/renovate baseline and layers on what differs here: pinned action digests, lock file maintenance, and a weekly roll-up of Actions bumps.

packageRules.description: Roll up routine GitHub Actions bumps into a single weekly PR (security PRs are unaffected)
Minimum Release Age cannot be enforced for lockFileMaintenance on non-npm ecosystems — the package manager controls version resolution
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Renovate's lockFileMaintenance does not validate Minimum Release Age — the package manager performs the version resolution. Review fresh transitive updates manually.
